title: staging and block_cache to_string_lossy silently corrupts non-UTF8 configured paths
description: staging.rs try_stage (line 143-146) and block_cache.rs do_cache_put (line 174-177) both compute file paths via PathBuf::join(...).to_string_lossy().into_owned(). On Linux, if config.path contains non-UTF-8 directory components, to_string_lossy silently replaces bytes with U+FFFD. The file may be created at a path different from what is stored in SQLite. drain_one reads back the corrupted string and fails to open the file, leaving articles permanently stuck in staging with no error distinguishable from transient I/O failure. Fix: reject non-UTF-8 paths at config validation time (easy), or use Path throughout and store paths as BLOB in SQLite.
